name: 1. In the Crowd
description: Low viewpoint among jumping silhouettes; a tiny red-and-amber stage glows at the back.

name: 2. Back of the Basement
description: A dense sea of dark heads and hands, compressed beneath a low ceiling, with dusty blue and warm white light.

name: 3. The Basement Pit
description: A looser dancing crowd in chunky cut-paper shapes, with a distant stage under faded red and green lights.
